question: What name and nature are attributed to the protective armor described in this text?
premises: The armor is named auspicious for the three worlds
It is explicitly called a kavaca
It is described as having the form of brahman
inference: The protective armor is named Trailokyamaṅgala and is of the nature of brahman.
plain_english: This armor, named 'Auspicious for the Three Worlds', has the form of Brahman.
